title: Exploration of the mechanism of Qinglongyi-Buguzhi drug pair in treating vitiligo based on network pharmacology, molecular docking and experimental verification.
authors: Chen, Lele; Chen, Shuguang; Li, Pengze; Zhao, Xiangfeng; Sun, Peng; Liu, Xinyue; Wei, Hong; Jiang, Xiaolong; Zhan, Zhaoshuang; Wang, Jiafeng
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证研究中药药对治疗白癜风的机制，核心是药物-靶点-通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The Qinglongyi-Buguzhi herbal pair (QB) is one of commonly used herbal combinations for treating vitiligo in traditional Chinese medicine, consisting of the exocarp of the immature fruit of Juglans regia L. or Juglans mandshurica Maxim., and dried, mature fruit of Psoralea corylifolia L. However, the active components and potential mechanisms of QB in the treatment of vitiligo are still unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of this study is to clarify the effects and mechanisms of QB on vitiligo treatment through integration of network pharmacology and empirical examinations. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The active components and targets of QB as well as the targets linked to vitiligo were obtained from network databases. Visualization networks were constructed with Cytoscape 3.9.1. GO and KEGG enrichment analysis were conducted to investigate the possible mechanism. Molecular docking was employed to evaluate the binding affinities between the primary active ingredients of QB and essential targets of the PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 pathway. In vivo and in vitro experiments were carried out to confirm the results of network pharmacology. RESULTS: We evaluated 44 active compounds and 602 genes from QB, and 107 of these genes linked to vitiligo. GO analysis suggested QB might lessen vitiligo by regulating oxidative stress. KEGG pathway analysis indicated the PI3K/Akt pathway may be crucial for treating vitiligo. Molecular docking results demonstrated the key active ingredients of QB had good binding activity with the major targets in the PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 pathway. In vivo, QB significantly ameliorated vitiligo model mouse's skin pathologies by reducing ROS, elevating CAT and SOD levels. Western blot showed that QB increased the phosphorylation of PI3K and Akt and the expressions of Nrf2 and HO-1 in the skin. In vitro, QB reversed H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative injury of melanocytes, enhanced cell survival rate, reduced ROS level, upregulated SOD and CAT activities, and raised the content of melanin. Moreover, QB upregulated the expression levels of Akt, Nrf2, HO-1 mRNA, Akt phosphorylation, HO-1, and nuclear Nrf2 proteins, and also encouraged the nuclear translocation of Nrf2. However, LY294002 treatment significantly reversed the regulatory effect of QB on oxidative damage of melanocytes. CONCLUSIONS: This study revealed that the therapeutic effect of QB on vitiligo was achieved through multiple components, targets and pathways. Experimental investigation demonstrated that QB could improve vitiligo via reducing oxidative stress, which was probably accomplished by activating the PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：青龙衣-补骨脂药对（QB）是传统中医治疗白癜风常用的草药组合之一，由核桃（Juglans regia L.）或核桃楸（Juglans mandshurica Maxim.）未成熟果实的外果皮，以及补骨脂（Psoralea corylifolia L.）的干燥成熟果实组成。然而，QB治疗白癜风的活性成分和潜在机制仍不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在通过网络药理学和实验验证的整合，阐明QB治疗白癜风的效果和机制。材料与方法：从网络数据库中获取QB的活性成分和靶点，以及与白癜风相关的靶点。使用Cytoscape 3.9.1构建可视化网络。进行GO和KEGG富集分析以探讨可能机制。采用分子对接评估QB主要活性成分与PI3K/Akt/Nrf2通路关键靶点之间的结合亲和力。进行体内和体外实验以验证网络药理学结果。结果：我们从QB中评估了44种活性化合物和602个基因，其中107个基因与白癜风相关。GO分析提示QB可能通过调节氧化应激减轻白癜风。KEGG通路分析表明PI3K/Akt通路可能对治疗白癜风至关重要。分子对接结果显示，QB的关键活性成分与PI3K/Akt/Nrf2通路中的主要靶点具有良好的结合活性。在体内，QB通过降低ROS、提高CAT和SOD水平，显著改善了白癜风模型小鼠的皮肤病理状况。Western blot显示，QB增加了皮肤中PI3K和Akt的磷酸化以及Nrf2和HO-1的表达。在体外，QB逆转了H(2)O(2)诱导的黑素细胞氧化损伤，提高了细胞存活率，降低了ROS水平，上调了SOD和CAT活性，并增加了黑色素含量。此外，QB上调了Akt、Nrf2、HO-1 mRNA的表达水平，以及Akt磷酸化、HO-1和核Nrf2蛋白的表达，并促进了Nrf2的核转位。然而，LY294002处理显著逆转了QB对黑素细胞氧化损伤的调节作用。结论：本研究揭示，QB对白癜风的治疗效果是通过多成分、多靶点和多通路实现的。实验验证表明，QB可能通过激活PI3K/Akt/Nrf2信号通路来减轻氧化应激，从而改善白癜风。
